resources.string: Try operating an app on a separate screen while keeping your main screen available. Setup happens on this phone; no computer is needed.

Shell assistance can create a separate display, open apps and send input on that display. Your choice stays enabled until you revoke it. Setup does not start a task. A separate opt-in Agent trial can operate the built-in test screen only.

In About phone, tap Build number seven times to enable Developer options. Then enable USB debugging and Wireless debugging. USB debugging helps recovery after a restart; no cable is needed. Menu names vary by phone.

Connect to Wi-Fi and open Pair device with pairing code in Wireless debugging. Keep that dialog open. Pull down the notification shade and enter the six digits in the Tapilot notification. Ports are found automatically.
Keep the system pairing dialog open. Enter its six-digit code here.
Enter exactly six digits. Open a fresh system pairing dialog if the code expired.
Looking for this phone. Open Wireless debugging to pair or reconnect.
Pairing this phone… Keep the system dialog open.
Shell assistance connected. Try the screen to check compatibility.
Connection needs attention. Check Wi-Fi, USB debugging and Wireless debugging, then retry. Existing pairing is kept.
Pairing failed or the code expired. Reopen the system pairing dialog and enter its new code in the notification.
Shell assistance is off. Your main-screen tasks are unaffected.
Revoke authorization and delete the local pairing key? Also remove Tapilot from Paired devices in system Wireless debugging.

Optional: allow Tapilot to obtain the Android secure-settings permission and use it to re-enable Wireless debugging on a Wi-Fi network you have approved, including after a restart. It will not change Wi-Fi networks, enable accessibility, or resume interrupted tasks. Turn this off or revoke authorization to stop automatic recovery.
Automatic recovery needs setup. Keep USB debugging on and reconnect once; if this phone refuses the permission, restore Wireless debugging manually.
Only needed if automatic discovery or notifications fail. Use split screen with Tapilot and Settings so the system pairing dialog stays open. Pairing and connection ports are different.
Pairing port from the system dialog
A test screen will appear. Tap its button through the floating preview to check that input reaches the separate screen. No personal apps are opened.
This settings shortcut is unavailable. Open Developer options from system Settings.
Automatic recovery is available. Interrupted tasks still need your confirmation.
Shell assistance is enabled. Tap to manage or revoke it.
Tap the button inside the floating screen. Waiting for a real click…
The screen is closed. You can try again; shell authorization is still enabled.
This phone could not complete the screen test. Return to setup to check the connection, or retry.
Shell assistance disconnected. Return to setup to restore it. This trial will not restart automatically.
Allow display over other apps to see the floating screen. After enabling it, return here to start the trial.
A five-minute request is ready. On an already authorized computer, run this command from the Tapilot repository. This is optional; normal setup needs no computer.
This phone has not granted automatic recovery permission. Open Wireless debugging manually when it turns off. Pairing and the background screen remain available.
